title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Bellco Theatre, Denver | 2026
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Bellco Theatre in Denver, Colorado, USA, on 9 June 2026.

It was the ninth show of the 16th All-Starr Band’s tour of the USA, which lasted for 12 dates in May and June 2026.

Starr had previously performed at the Bellco Theatre on 6 June 2023.

The 16th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Buck Johnson: vocals, keyboards
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet

  • ‘Matchbox’
  • It Don’t Come Easy
  • ‘Rosanna’ (Steve Lukather)
  • ‘Pick Up The Pieces’ (Hamish Stuart)
  • ‘Down Under’ (Colin Hay)
  • ‘Boys’
  • ‘I’m The Greatest’
  • ‘Yellow Submarine’
  • ‘Cut The Cake’ (Hamish Stuart)
  • ‘Octopus’s Garden’
  • ‘No No Song’
  • ‘Choose Love’
  • ‘Overkill’ (Colin Hay)
  • ‘Africa’ (Steve Lukather)
  • ‘Work To Do’ (Hamish Stuart)
  • ‘I Wanna Be Your Man’
  • ‘Who Can It Be Now?’ (Colin Hay)
  • ‘Hold The Line’ (Steve Lukather)
  • ‘Photograph’
  • ‘Act Naturally’
  • ‘With A Little Help From My Friends’
  • ‘Give Peace A Chance’
